mapper.sql: interpretation_id AS interpretationId, report_id AS reportId, parse_version AS parseVersion, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, status, result_code AS resultCode, kb_version AS kbVersion, rule_version AS ruleVersion, prompt_version AS promptVersion, parser_version AS parserVersion, schema_version AS schemaVersion, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_interpretation (interpretation_id, report_id, parse_version, idempotency_key, status, result_code, kb_version, rule_version, prompt_version, parser_version, schema_version, created_at) VALUES (#{interpretationId}, #{reportId}, #{parseVersion}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{resultCode}, #{kbVersion}, #{ruleVersion}, #{promptVersion}, #{parserVersion}, #{schemaVersion}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM report_interpretation WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, interpretation_id DESC LIMIT 1
